sharedProposal.status: UNADOPTED AND UNSENT. Fifteen proposed mechanical procedures with complete originals and current comparisons. No public spell, class access, review count, source book or cosmology is changed. All added procedures are explicit NEW proposals, not approval or runtime evidence.
sharedProposal.casting: All fifteen retain Action and V/S/F. Use the actual casting class’s rank, school, minimum class level, independently acquired repertoire and base RP price. A legal cast commits costs, concentration transitions and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain before interruption. Failure, immunity, missing information and countering give no refund or restoration of old concentration. Use actual casting ability + PB for attacks and 8 + PB + that modifier for save DC; ordinary saves are binary. No generic upcast, additional Action or inferred class-card access.
sharedProposal.time: Unless a card states otherwise, a minute ends at the caster’s tenth future original regular-start marker, excluding a start underway, or after 60 elapsed seconds if begun outside initiative. Retain original virtual markers or absolute deadlines through reorder, extra turns, absence and travel. Suppression never pauses a clock, refunds spent history or replays an application. Later saved-against casts do not dispel an older valid application. Extra turns do not supply extra periodic pulses, order opportunities or repeat saves.
sharedProposal.information: Use actual established facts and each information protection’s real subject and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts can be read; missing facts are not invented. An unavailable answer does not identify the hidden reason. Ordinary observed outcomes and inferences remain possible. No new faction roster, plane, moral axis, cosmic force, secret doctrine or guaranteed destiny is authored. The pending expedition reputation verdict is not presumed.
sharedProposal.control: A successfully established hard whole-Action/turn component spends the shared source-character/target/encounter guard once. Its continued valid duration does not claim a new allowance each turn. Initial prevention leaves no banked component; later suppression retains the existing clock and spent history. A blocked component gets no unprinted fallback. Actual component immunities remain separate; creature type alone is no blanket mental immunity. Limited attack or movement restrictions do not become whole-Action denial merely because alternatives are unattractive.
sharedProposal.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. A valid order/table instruction receives its priority timestamp when issued or generated at that opportunity; simultaneous instructions use application order then stable source ID. A losing instruction gets no second budget and does not erase an earlier mandate. Actual ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks unless the card expressly limits them to one. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. Bonus Actions, Reactions and extra Actions remain target-controlled. Hostile conduct uses ordinary initiative before execution, never a free virtual pre-initiative attack.
sharedProposal.newCompanionBinding: NEW for an actually eligible Humanoid under Dominate Person, or any eligible Confusion target, using an owner-attached companion chassis: use the actual original-owner regular attached phase, original profile and structural command/offense caps. No independent turn, dominator companion allowance or unwilling owner Bonus Action is created. A pending command reservation can be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, under the reviewed Dominate Beast bridge; spent or another companion’s reservation cannot be stolen. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. If no such phase is currently supplied, only an END-only six-second save schedule continues, with no orders/actions. On transitioning to actual phases, map the next unresolved save to the next regular phase end, preserve resolved saves and the original maximum, and never replay an opportunity. This extension is proposed explicitly; it is not already conferred by Dominate Beast.
sharedProposal.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.
sharedProposal.newCompanionPulseBinding: NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.

records.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: target one perceived creature with line of effect, choose anger, fear or pain, and maintain concentration up to one minute. On the initial save only, a willing creature can elect failure; otherwise it makes WIS. On failure suppress experience of the chosen emotion for the duration without deleting its causes, memories or underlying records. Choosing fear additionally suppresses actual Frightened effects, including later applications, while their clocks and repeat saves continue. Other emotion choices do not erase Frightened. Under every mode, the target cannot initiate an actual rage-state component explicitly identified as such by its operational source, or a component whose text actually inflicts Frightened. This is an explicit NEW mechanical definition of rage/fear abilities, not a keyword search through names. A solely prohibited activation fails preflight; a mixed activation can perform its legal nonprohibited parts at its full ordinary cost, with no prohibited rider. While the spell operates, an already active personal rage-state component is suppressed and new Frightened-generating triggers originating from the target are suppressed. Independent Frightened records already inflicted on other creatures are not cured or erased. Generic fear immunity and emotion-themed titles alone do not qualify. In particular, Mooncursed’s nonfear body/bite/healing functions, Divine Fury’s nonfear attack benefits and Fury of the Host remain governed by their actual components; Mooncursed’s fear Howl, Divine Fury’s critical Frightened rider and Intimidating Presence’s actual fear output are prohibited. No source grants a new rage state merely to create a match. Repeat WIS at affected regular ENDs, including when originally willing, ending on success; acceptance is not a freely toggled dispel. No healing, pain-damage prevention, wound repair, revival, strain reduction, friendliness or generic Incapacitated cure occurs.
records.newChoices: NEW: chosen-emotion suppression, exact rage/Frightened-component predicate, mixed-effect handling, concentration minute and END saves. This is broader than Calm Emotions only where expressly defined.
workedCases: A Warrior’s solely fear-producing Intimidating Presence cannot activate. A Mooncursed nonfear Howl option remains available at its real cost.

records.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes WIS. Success does nothing. At that START after normal processing and before voluntary movement, spend up to 30 feet of the target’s actual remaining ordinary movement moving as far as reasonably possible in that direction along a legal known route. The target/controller selects the safest legal route; use only its actual available movement modes, support and distances. No knowingly self-destructive route, unsupported step, prohibited transport or optional resource expenditure is compelled. Ordinary opportunity attacks remain possible; this is compelled use of movement, not push/pull displacement. No Dash, Action loss, extra movement, teleport permission or new speed is supplied. A blocked route or Speed 0 permits only the actual safe meaningful movement available, possibly none; no alternative direction or banked retry follows. The instruction competes through existing compelled-budget arbitration with priority at establishment. It expires after this opportunity. Outside initiative resolve one ordinary movement opportunity within six elapsed seconds; establish initiative first when combat timing matters. A companion uses only movement in its next actual original-owner regular attached phase, with no extra phase, Action, offensive allowance or owner resource charge. NEW: one pending application per caster/target; a later actually established application replaces that caster’s prior one. Other casters’ instructions retain distinct histories but cannot reset the same movement budget. Suppression at the execution opportunity prevents execution without deferring it.

The immediate and later Illusion packets share one exposure per target per numbered round across this spell’s Illusion applications. If an earlier one already used that exposure, this new application establishes its legal components but adds no second initial packet. At future regular target STARTs after normal start processing, deal 4d10 psychic only when that round’s exposure remains unused. preparedCompleteRecord.name: Mark Omen

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; creature type alone adds no exclusion.
operational.duration: Up to 1 hour, until consumed; no concentration. Expires 3,600 elapsed seconds after application, regardless of initiative changes, absence, death or planar travel. Ends earlier when the marked creature dies, is destroyed or its summoned existence ends.
operational.resolution: No initial save. Once while the mark lasts, when you make an attack against that creature, you may consume the mark after the complete initial attack d20 result is visible but before hit/miss resolution. This costs no additional Action or Reaction. Replace the entire attack d20 procedure using the original modifiers and advantage/disadvantage state; use the replacement result even if worse.
operational.effect: The mark is invisible and nonphysical. A two-d20 advantage/disadvantage attack receives a complete new two-d20 set and the ordinary higher/lower selection; a single-d20 attack receives one new d20. Do not reroll damage or modifiers. Resolve natural 1, natural 20, expanded critical eligibility and the hit/miss result only from the final attack result under their actual rules. The attack must already be legal under its own range, sight and line-of-effect requirements; the mark adds no continuing 30-foot tether, tracking information or new targeting permission. One active Mark Omen per caster; a successful new mark replaces the old one. Different casters can independently mark a creature for their own attacks.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Ordinary shapechange retaining creature identity does not remove the mark. Actual death, destruction or ended summoned existence ends it; revival/reconstruction/resummoning does not revive that application. Information-only protection does not itself cancel this noninformational reroll permission. No ammo, RP, component, class use or other original attack cost is refunded or charged again, and the replaced result produces no separate hit/miss/on-hit outcome. A legally committed mark stays spent if an exact later interrupt prevents completion. Mark Omen and Fate Coin share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from either of these two spells, across all casters, coins, marks and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these two spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use a fixed neutral table order chosen before the roll. Only the first legal commitment spends a mark/coin; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, one attack reroll against a marked creature within one hour. CONFLICT RULING: finite one-hour pending mark replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: caster’s own attack only, no extra action/reaction, full d20-set replacement before hit/miss, fixed lineage guard shared only with Fate Coin and creature-identity endings.

operational.targets: Your free hand or the free hand of one willing creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect.
operational.duration: Up to 1 hour, until expended or destroyed; no concentration. Expires 3,600 elapsed seconds after application, regardless of initiative changes, absence, death or planar travel.
operational.resolution: Conjure one noncurrency Tiny magical coin, AC10/HP1, mass0.01pound. A current holder with a usable hand may flip and expend it as a Reaction after the complete original roll event has been rolled and its die faces are available under ordinary table information rules, but before that roll's mechanical consequences are applied. Choose one physical die from that completed original roll and reroll only it. There is no separate heads/tails success test. The coin vanishes and its use commits when the legal Reaction begins.
operational.effect: The holder must perceive the creature/object generating the roll or the actual local event being resolved, within 30 feet and line of effect. Physical tabletop dice location is irrelevant. The roll can belong to the holder, an ally or an enemy; no target consent is required. Its result must actually be available to the reacting player under the table’s normal information rules; the coin does not reveal secret rolls or fabricate perception. Choose one physical die from that original roll. Reroll only it and use the new face: for two-d20 advantage/disadvantage reselect the higher/lower normally; for a multi-die damage, healing or resource pool recompute the original total; for a single-die attack/check/save use its new face. All original modifiers, other dice, target selection and source rules remain. If the roll is shared across targets, use the same modified shared result for all of them. An initial Resonance Well reserve d4 may be changed before the reserve is established, but an already established reserve cannot be rerolled or refilled.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration, uses or information.
operational.limitations: One active Fate Coin per caster; successful recasting replaces the previous unspent coin wherever it is. Ordinary handing/dropping/custody and hands apply; a handoff never refreshes the charge, endpoint or caster cap. The spell adds no separate one-coin-per-holder cap: several casters may supply distinct coins, still constrained by actual hands, Reactions and the shared roll guard. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use a fixed neutral table order chosen before the roll. Only the first legal commitment spends a mark/coin; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement, although an applicable concentration transition has already happened. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs commit before the counter window without refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Explicit remote-destination/concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect only as printed. Specific information protections apply to their actual subject and generating-source scope; hidden but unprotected facts are valid information, and missing facts are never invented. preparedCompleteRecord.name: Locate Object

operational.targets: Self; one specific object personally familiar to you through at least 1 minute of prior direct observation or handling
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
operational.resolution: None.
operational.effect: If the specified familiar object is within 1,000 feet on the same plane and is not protected from divination, sense the direction from you to its current location. The directional sense updates while the spell lasts.
operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: Provides direction only, not exact distance, route, floor, container, bearer identity, object condition, surrounding creatures, or a path around barriers. Fails if the object is outside 1,000 feet, on another plane, transformed beyond recognition into a different object, or protected by an effect explicitly blocking divination. Repeated casts cannot reveal protected/secret facts beyond the object's direction. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Conference decision: casting range0/self is separate from the source effect's1000ft detection radius. Preserve conflicting Universal30ft metadata as evidence. Ten-minute concentration and familiarity threshold are provisional specifications; no exact location, distance or hidden properties are revealed.
operational.previousDraftDesignNotes: NEW provisional familiarity requirement, 10-minute concentration duration, and divination limits. Source 1,000-foot directional location of a familiar object is preserved despite conflicting source placement levels.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Locate Person

operational.targets: Self; designate one intended specific person through personal acquaintance or a reliable identity description/name intended to refer to one actual individual.
operational.duration: Instantaneous bearing
operational.resolution: No save. After costs are committed, resolve whether the designation identifies one actual qualifying person and whether that person currently exists as an eligible creature on your plane within 5,280 feet with readable location information. If so, privately learn the direction, including meaningful vertical bearing. Otherwise receive no direction, without distinguishing ambiguity, death/destruction, range, plane, eligibility or protection. Ordinary walls, cover and lack of originating line of effect do not block a permitted bearing; no prior 30-foot mark or encounter is required.
operational.effect: Person is an individual-identity predicate, not automatically Humanoid or biologically living. An active Undead or Construct can qualify if the campaign treats it as that continuing person. A corpse or object does not qualify merely because it belonged to or once was a person. Ordinary shapechange or disguise retaining the same continuing identity does not defeat designation. You learn direction only, without distance, precise coordinates, floor/room, route, appearance, condition or companions. This is a snapshot at resolution; later movement is not updated.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.
operational.limitations: If the designation is ambiguous, or the person is dead/destroyed, outside the mile, on another plane, not an eligible creature/person, or protected, receive no direction without learning which reason applies. A mistaken name that does not reliably identify one actual individual is not a search through possible matches. This spell creates no mark, tracking token, map, teleport permission, ongoing detection or proof of life from an absent bearing. Repeated legal paid casts can provide new snapshots subject to the same limits. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and direction to a specific person within one mile. CONFLICT RULING: Self informational receiver with one-mile remote reach replaces raw 30-foot metadata; rangeFeet 0 denotes the receiver, not a cap on the explicitly stated bearing radius. NEW: unambiguous individual identification, continuing-person predicate and indistinguishable no-direction outcomes.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Faction Divination

operational.targets: Self; choose one exact known canonical factionId.
operational.duration: Instantaneous private institutional inquiry
operational.resolution: No roll. Privately learn one actual current major institutional objective of the chosen faction. No physical representative, positive reputation, membership, Faction Seal permission, geographic distance or planar anchor is required.
operational.effect: A qualifying objective is a concrete established goal pursued or prioritized by the institution or its recognized governing authority, such as securing a trade route, recovering a stolen archive or removing a named governor from office. A member’s private wish, reputation inference or the Director’s preferred plot is not an institutional objective. If several objectives are genuinely coequal, the Director records one stable priority selection while that institutional state remains materially unchanged. Equivalent repeat casts across casters/rephrasing do not rotate through hidden coequal goals. Report No Current Major Objective only for genuine established absence; undefined or specifically protected institutional information reports Indeterminate. Independently readable portions of a meaningful goal may be stated while protected details remain Indeterminate, without identifying which ward or hidden record caused the limit.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Protection of one leader’s personal information does not erase an independently established institutional objective, and a protected private plan does not become institutional merely to evade protection. A subfaction must have its own actual canonical identity to be selected separately; invented subdivisions are not extra inquiries. The spell does not directly reveal an operational plan, member list, exact locations, timetable, secret agents, resources or every subordinate objective. A goal can naturally mention a readable subject as necessary to make it concrete, but supplies no additional dossier. It changes neither reputation nor faction intent and forces no action. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and one current major faction objective. CONFLICT RULING: Self abstract informational casting replaces raw 60-foot metadata. NEW: exact institutional predicate, no geographic/planar anchor, stable coequal objective, and truthful absence versus undefined/protected output.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Faction Spy

operational.targets: Self; choose one specifically identifiable headquarters of one exact canonical faction and the qualifying room/area to observe.
operational.duration: 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No roll. Select the exact faction and a specific established headquarters belonging to it. Institutional identification can suffice without street coordinates, such as the faction’s established central headquarters in a named city. A faction name alone cannot discover an unknown or secret HQ. Select one specific named room/common area of that HQ you know, or use its established primary common/operations area. If no such area is established, use the ordinary main interior space nearest its primary public/working entrance. No reputation, membership, Faction Seal or special infrastructure is required.
operational.effect: Create a fixed nonphysical observation point at the center of the selected room/area’s ordinarily usable interior space, at an ordinary standing observer’s eye height. If that point is inside solid matter, use the nearest open point within the same selected space; the Director resolves equal choices with a fixed neutral spatial order. operational.targets: Self; one specifically declared course of action you intend to begin within the next minute, judged against one concrete goal for you, your party or another identified beneficiary.
operational.duration: Instantaneous forecast; evaluates the 30 minutes following the proposed beginning of the course.
operational.resolution: No roll. State the course, its intended beginning within 60 elapsed seconds of resolution, and its concrete goal or interest before receiving the answer. The Director privately answers exactly Yes, No or Unclear using the most likely material consequences under current circumstances during the 30 minutes following that proposed beginning.
operational.effect: Yes means the course is more likely than not to materially advance the stated goal. No means it is more likely than not to materially harm, frustrate or move away from that goal. Unclear means favorable and unfavorable consequences are materially balanced/mixed, the course is too contingent to favor either result, or information necessary for the judgment is undefined or protected. A course with no material effect on the stated goal is Unclear. Good/bad refers to this practical goal, not moral alignment or the Director’s preferred plot; a dangerous action that advances the goal can be Yes. Uncertainty alone is not grounds for Unclear when current evidence materially favors Yes or No.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.
operational.limitations: This predicts rather than fixes destiny. Later voluntary choices, new events and die results can change the outcome. It reveals neither future dice nor a full causal explanation, hidden actor identities, room contents or a guaranteed plan. Materially equivalent course/goal inquiries under unchanged circumstances return the same answer across casters, rephrasing and repeated casts. Genuinely different courses/goals or materially changed circumstances may yield different answers. No additional daily cap applies. The answer does not identify which protection or missing fact caused Unclear. The one-minute beginning requirement is an inquiry condition, not a sustained magical deadline or obligation forcing the caster to act. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and Yes/No/Unclear outcome inquiry. CONFLICT RULING: Self informational mode replaces raw 30-foot metadata. NEW: concrete goal, beginning within one minute, 30-minute forecast horizon, stable equivalent inquiries and useful likelihood standard. Exact completion anchors the horizon to the declared beginning and treats materially neutral outcomes as Unclear.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Alignment Prediction

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; one concrete imminent situation, offer, confrontation or decision it is reasonably expected to encounter within the next minute.
operational.duration: Instantaneous forecast of the specified imminent situation
operational.resolution: No save. State the particular scenario before the answer. The Director privately reports the creature’s single most likely voluntary response under current circumstances, using its actual individual state, including actual alignment where relevant. Valid results include likely refuses, likely cooperates cautiously, likely attacks, likely bargains, or a comparably specific response. Report Indeterminate when necessary facts are genuinely undefined/protected or materially coequal alternatives prevent a single most likely response.
operational.effect: Use the individual’s actual motives, relationships, danger, knowledge and other relevant facts; these can outweigh an alignment tendency. Hidden unprotected facts may inform the forecast without being separately disclosed. Alignment is not a behavioral command, and the spell does not force any response, dictate a player character’s choice, trigger automatic oathbreaking or authorize compulsory PvP. Uncertainty or free will alone does not make an otherwise supported prediction Indeterminate. The situation must be reasonably expected within 60 elapsed seconds of resolution; the result forecasts the immediate voluntary response to it, not an entire later chain of choices.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, damage or information.
operational.limitations: Do not separately disclose exact alignment axes, full motives, surface thoughts, future die results, guaranteed success or a complete conversation transcript. A naturally inferable tendency from the permitted response is ordinary inference, not additional direct disclosure. Later free choices or materially changed circumstances can invalidate the prediction without falsifying the earlier current-circumstances forecast. Materially equivalent scenarios under unchanged circumstances return the same forecast across casters/rephrasing; genuinely different scenarios or materially changed facts can be asked normally. There is no daily cap beyond legal casting costs and cadence, and an Indeterminate result does not identify the hidden/protected reason. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Committed costs are not refunded by a failed or countered effect, and prior concentration is not restored. Only explicit remote-destination or concealment exceptions override ordinary originating line of effect. Information protections apply to their actual subject and source scope; hidden but unprotected facts remain valid, and undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or upcast.

NEW: specified imminent scenario, one-minute horizon, single likely response or Indeterminate, no separate alignment read and stable equivalent inquiries. preparedCompleteRecord.name: Resonance Sight (Greater)

operational.targets: Self; magical effects within 60 feet on your plane and in line of effect.
operational.duration: Instantaneous private snapshot
operational.resolution: No roll. Detect every currently existing qualifying magical effect with a readable portion in the area. Ordinary non-solid visual concealment and lack of mundane visibility, including Hidden/Invisible status, do not hide the effect itself. Solid total cover blocks the unreadable portion. This informational detection does not require ordinary visual sight of the effect.
operational.effect: For each qualifying effect, privately receive its readable local location/footprint, actual effect/spell/property identity when explicitly established and unprotected (otherwise its established broad magical category), and recorded readable proximate generating source. Undefined/protected identity and provenance fields independently report Indeterminate, without erasing other readable fields. Proximate source means the specific originating spell cast/caster identity, item producing an active property, creature/feature producing an aura, or site/zone/ritual generating that effect. A locally qualifying effect can disclose its recorded source identity even when that source is now beyond 60 feet, but not that source’s current remote location, condition or inventory. Record source identity as it actually exists; a missing personal name is not invented. A footprint is clipped to the readable area, rather than exposing the entire remote extent of a partially local effect.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Active intrinsic magic requires an actual presently active magical effect/aura record; a creature’s species/theme or RP pool alone is not one. A permanent item qualifies through a currently active property/effect, not a dormant historical enchantment with no active record. An existing ongoing record that is suppressed remains detectable as suppressed if that state is readable; an ended/removed effect or mere extinguished residue does not qualify. Resonance Tracking separately governs one-hour spell traces. A copy is identified as the actual copied effect and its proximate copying source, not a fresh original cast. Readable explicitly recorded provenance may identify the immediate source relationship but grants no independent recursive search through upstream controllers or histories. An attached aura can reveal its creature’s location through ordinary inference without granting sight of that body. Actual subject information protections can withhold attached-magic details, while independent environmental magic remains separately readable. No universal spell-rank/slot/charge/RP total, recipe, full stat block, dispel, control, extraction, copied spell, remote attack/casting origin or permanent map is granted. Remembering or writing a permitted snapshot uses ordinary memory and tools. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F/instantaneous and all magical effects and their sources within 60 feet. CONFLICT RULING: Self with a 60-foot same-plane/line-of-effect sensing radius. NEW: local readable footprint, effect identity/category and proximate provenance, non-solid concealment bypass, actual ongoing suppressed versus ended/dormant distinctions and no direct remote-current-location report.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, numerical balance and broader system validation pending

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Charm Person

operational.targets: One living person you can perceive within range
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On failure, it gains the CoreV2 Charmed condition toward you and regards you as friendly for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, and the first time each round you or your allies damage it, it repeats the Wisdom save; success ends the spell. On the initial save success, no effect.
operational.effect: Charm one person so it temporarily regards you as friendly. Charmed does not grant command authority, compel beliefs, reveal secrets, or force the target to obey requests.
operational.scaling: None.
operational.limitations: A player-controlled target retains full agency over choices and beliefs. The spell cannot force self-harm, confession, permanent allegiance, transfer of possessions, or actions beyond the CoreV2 Charmed restrictions. A creature that cannot be Charmed is unaffected. Only the first damage event each round grants the additional repeat save. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and Wisdom save are retained; F is represented as an existing class casting focus. Core lists Instantaneous duration, which conflicts with 'regards caster as friendly' and 'save ends early.' Concentration up to 1 minute and repeat-save cadence are NEW provisional operational decisions. Two source school placements are preserved externally; this record does not choose class access.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Pacify

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect and presently treat as an enemy using ordinary information; this declaration reveals no hidden hostility.
operational.duration: One target round, no concentration. Ends at the target's first future regular-turn END, excluding the entire current target turn if already underway. Outside initiative, the deadline is six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; end-phase effects precede cleanup.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new restriction. Failure: it cannot voluntarily initiate an attack or begin/cast a spell whose selected mode includes a damage-dealing payload during the duration.
operational.effect: The prohibition applies across Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and other actual attack/cast permissions. A spell with multiple modes can be cast through a genuinely nondamaging mode. Deliberately established delayed or ongoing damage from that selected cast counts; a miss, successful victim save, immunity or hoped-for zero damage does not turn a damage payload into a nondamaging mode. Existing attacks/spells whose commitments already occurred are not undone or stopped retroactively by this application. The creature retains movement, interactions, non-damaging spells/control and other legal choices.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: This is not a blanket ban on every harmful nonattack technique and does not forbid harm merely because it is harmful: use the printed attack/damaging-spell categories. Truly involuntary acts retain their separate rules. No harm-ending clause is added; being attacked does not remove Pacify. This limited prohibition does not consume the whole-Action hard-control allowance merely because the creature lacks attractive alternatives. One Pacify restriction per caster/target; later failed save refreshes it, successful save does not remove it; independent other-caster records keep their own deadlines. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, enemy cannot attack or cast damaging spells for1round. NEW: WIS save, ordinary enemy designation and voluntary initiation/selected-damage-mode scope. Damage capability is determined from the selected effect, not a future hit or HP-loss prediction.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending

currentSourceCatalogRecord.name: Pacify

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect and presently treat as an enemy using ordinary information; this declaration reveals no hidden hostility.
operational.duration: One target round, no concentration. Ends at the target's first future regular-turn END, excluding the entire current target turn if already underway. Outside initiative, the deadline is six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; end-phase effects precede cleanup.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new restriction. Failure: it cannot voluntarily initiate an attack or begin/cast a spell whose selected mode includes a damage-dealing payload during the duration.
operational.effect: The prohibition applies across Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and other actual attack/cast permissions. A spell with multiple modes can be cast through a genuinely nondamaging mode. Deliberately established delayed or ongoing damage from that selected cast counts; a miss, successful victim save, immunity or hoped-for zero damage does not turn a damage payload into a nondamaging mode. Existing attacks/spells whose commitments already occurred are not undone or stopped retroactively by this application. The creature retains movement, interactions, non-damaging spells/control and other legal choices.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: This is not a blanket ban on every harmful nonattack technique and does not forbid harm merely because it is harmful: use the printed attack/damaging-spell categories. Truly involuntary acts retain their separate rules. No harm-ending clause is added; being attacked does not remove Pacify. This limited prohibition does not consume the whole-Action hard-control allowance merely because the creature lacks attractive alternatives. One Pacify restriction per caster/target; later failed save refreshes it, successful save does not remove it; independent other-caster records keep their own deadlines. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, enemy cannot attack or cast damaging spells for1round. NEW: WIS save, ordinary enemy designation and voluntary initiation/selected-damage-mode scope. Damage capability is determined from the selected effect, not a future hit or HP-loss prediction.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Voice of Peace

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect and ordinarily treat as an enemy. Use an audible language you can speak; its actual hearing/understanding is checked at paid resolution without a diagnostic.
operational.duration: Up to1minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. Outside initiative, expires after 60 elapsed seconds. Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it.
operational.resolution: If the chosen creature cannot hear and understand your words at resolution, no ceasefire applies. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: none. Failure: establish a ceasefire toward you and the creatures it then actually recognizes as your participating allies; record those participants at application.
operational.effect: The target cannot voluntarily initiate an attack or knowingly harmful effect against those recorded participants. It can act, move, speak, decline negotiation, defend through nonharmful choices and act against nonparticipants normally. End the ceasefire immediately if you or a recorded participating ally commits an attack or knowingly harmful effect against the target or someone the target actually recognizes at that event as its ally. Commitment breaks it even on a later miss/prevented effect. Mere insult, argument, approach, suspicion or unsupported threat does not count. Already committed outcomes are not reversed. Participants are fixed for this application: later allies are not silently enrolled; a new paid successful cast can establish a new set.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: Initial hearing, shared language, range and line of effect are not ongoing tethers. No forced treaty, agreement, Diplomacy success, permanent alliance, faction standing or Charmed condition. Recognized relationships use actual established knowledge, not a hidden membership/allegiance scan. One ceasefire per caster/target; new failed save replaces that caster’s old application/participant set/deadline, successful save or ineligible application leaves a valid old one intact. Other-caster ceasefires retain separate participants and endpoints. This limited harm restriction is not whole-Action denial. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, one enemy’s ceasefire unless provoked. NEW: WIS, minute, initial hearing/language and participant/provocation scope. Exact completion snapshots the protected participating group while checking actual recognition of the target’s allies at a provoking event.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Group Pacify

operational.targets: At resolution, snapshot every creature in a15-foot cone originating from you with line of effect from you that you ordinarily identify as an enemy. Use actual ordinary information; you cannot designate unknown hidden creatures by secretly knowing their hostility. No hearing or language gate.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to1 minute, with independent provocation ending for each target. In initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. Outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; a timing-mode change never resets it.
operational.resolution: Each snapshotted target independently makes a Wisdom save. Success: no restriction on that creature. Failure: impose the prospective hostile-initiation restriction below. The selected set is fixed; creatures entering the old cone later are not added.
operational.effect: An affected creature cannot voluntarily initiate a new combat-hostile act: an attack, damaging spell/effect, knowingly harmful control or knowingly harmful indirect action. This applies to all its actual action types/permissions, while movement, withdrawal, nonharmful defense, speech, interactions, healing, buffs and nonharmful control remain available. It can halt further hostile commitments in a fight already underway; it does not cancel initiative or rewind attacks/spells/effects committed before application. End this creature’s restriction immediately when any creature commits an attack or knowingly harmful effect against it or a creature it actually recognizes at that event as its ally. Commitment ends it even if the attack later misses or harm is prevented. No secret affiliation scan supplies that recognition.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: Mere insults, argument, proximity or unsupported threat do not provoke. Later voluntary decisions to select a damaging payload count even if damage ultimately becomes zero; existing mandatory outcomes from an already committed effect are not undone. Leaving the original cone, loss of hearing or later separation does not end this fixed-target application. No alliance, treaty, Charmed, automatic negotiation, blanket Action loss or manufactured hard-control use is imposed. Independent casts retain their own targets, concentration and deadlines; multiple identical prohibitions do not create additional penalties. Ending this caster’s concentration ends its remaining applications. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/15 feet/V,S,F, all enemies in15-foot cone and no combat initiation unless provoked. NEW: WIS, concentration minute, fixed initial set, broad hostile-act category, prospective applicability to ongoing fights and any-creature recognized-ally commitment provocation. Different from Pacify’s narrower attack/damaging-spell ban and Voice of Peace’s participating-group ceasefire.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect.
operational.duration: Pending until the target’s next regular turn; a single commanded behavior during that turn, then ends. Exclude any current in-progress target turn. Extra turns do not execute it. If no initiative exists when a compelled combat act matters, establish ordinary initiative; if no action sequence is needed, resolve the same one ordinary action/movement opportunity within six elapsed seconds. No indefinite pending command.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no command. On failure, roll a neutral1d2 immediately:1=Attack,2=Flee. Determine the branch before any caster/controller choice. Attack reserves/spends the shared hard-control allowance when its future command is established; if blocked, apply no Attack command and no substitute Flee. Flee is movement compulsion, not a whole-Action denial.
operational.effect: At the next regular turn after required start-phase events and before voluntary actions/movement, resolve the branch. Attack: if the creature can take its ordinary Action, neutrally select with equal probability among other creatures it can presently perceive and legally attack with at least one available ordinary weapon, natural or unarmed attack. The target/controller chooses one legal ordinary attack method against that victim and spends its normal Action on exactly that one attack; no Multiattack, extra attack, spell, charged technique or optional resource expenditure is compelled. Normal finite ammunition for its chosen attack is still required and spent. If no legal victim/method or no ordinary Action is available, no attack occurs and the command ends; it never turns an unavailable Action into an available one. Flee: spend as much of its ordinary available movement as reasonably possible increasing distance from the caster along a legal route it knows is not immediately self-destructive; the target/controller chooses the route. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; a timing-mode change never resets it.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: establish nothing and replace nothing. Failure: separately attempt Core Charmed toward you and the loyal-servant control component. Charmed immunity prevents Charmed only; applicable broader defenses may prevent the servant component. Successfully establishing servant control claims the shared hard-control allowance. A blocked servant component does not prevent independently legal Charmed. Successful Charmed replaces only this caster’s prior Dire Charm Charmed relation; successful servant control replaces only the one existing Dire Charm servant component on this target across casters. Apply those replacements component by component, only when the corresponding new component really establishes.
operational.effect: At each future regular target-turn beginning, after ordinary start-phase events, you may consciously give one brief audible order in a language the target actually hears and understands. This costs no Action/Bonus Action beyond ordinary brief communication. One coherent order may direct actual ordinary movement, one ordinary Action and one ordinary free interaction, such as approach a door, open it and attack a known guard. An ordered Attack Action uses the creature’s actual native ordinary attack sequence, including inherent Extra Attack or ordinary native Multiattack, without adding attacks beyond that Action. Ordinary required ammunition is spent normally; prohibited optional resources are not. The target/controller chooses legal details not fixed by the order. Bonus Actions, Reactions, separately granted extra Actions and independent permissions remain target-controlled. With no valid order, or no actually established servant component, it retains normal agency subject to actual Charmed and other effects. Repeat the recorded Wisdom save at each affected regular-turn END, including the current turn if applied during it; extra turns provide neither orders nor repeat saves. Success ends only components still active from that cast’s application ID.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: Initial range/line of effect is not a continuing tether. Every later order still requires actual conscious speech, hearing and understanding; unconsciousness, silence or another actual communication restriction may prevent an order without itself dispelling this non-concentration spell. A valid order lasts only for that turn/opportunity and is not banked into a later turn. This reference grants no additional action budget, sensory feed or otherwise unavailable permission. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.

preparedCompleteRecord.name: Calm Emotions

operational.targets: Choose a point you perceive within 20 feet and line of effect. Create a fixed 20-foot-radius sphere centered there. It can affect all creatures within the sphere with line of effect from its center, including allies, yourself and creatures you do not individually perceive; it supplies no roster or hidden-target diagnostic.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. A successfully applied record is active only during eligible exposure to this fixed zone. In initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. Outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; a timing-mode change never resets it.
operational.resolution: At a creature’s first eligible exposure to this application, a willing creature may accept automatically; otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. This is one application-specific acceptance/save decision, not a generic waiver of other spells’ saves. A successful save makes it unaffected by this cast for the rest of this cast, even on re-entry. Acceptance or failure creates this cast’s calm record. Geometrically present creatures behind total cover are not yet exposed; later exposure counts as their first eligible entry. Existing results are never rerolled merely because of leaving/re-entering, temporary cover, changed willingness or a new emotional trigger.
operational.effect: While its accepted/failed-save record is exposed, ordinary intense emotion such as panic, uncontrolled anger, grief or euphoria is subdued, and the mechanical effects of its actual Frightened condition records are suppressed. preparedCompleteRecord.name: Command

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect; speak one word in a language you know. Actual hearing/understanding and hidden impossibility/prohibited conduct are resolved after payment, not through a free targeting oracle.
operational.duration: One commanded regular turn, no concentration; ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding the current turn if underway. Extra turns do not execute the order. Outside initiative, resolve one ordinary behavior opportunity within6elapsed seconds; establish initiative if combat timing matters.
operational.resolution: If it cannot hear/understand the word, no command applies. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new command. Failure: it must perform a legal bounded interpretation on its next regular turn, using only its actual existing permissions. An impossible or prohibited command creates no behavior; no replacement word is chosen. Reserve the shared hard-control allowance when establishing any actual whole-Action/turn component. If blocked, only independently satisfiable non-hard movement/interaction portions may apply; do not invent another command.
operational.effect: After ordinary start-phase events, obey before contradictory voluntary choices. Approach: spend ordinary available movement toward you by a safe legal route, stopping on reaching an adjacent legal space or exhausting safe meaningful progress. Flee: spend ordinary available movement away by a safe legal route. Neither forces Dash or grants movement. Drop: ordinarily release one releasable held object chosen by the target/controller, using its actual ordinary release permission; ownership never transfers and normal later recovery remains possible. Halt: refrain from voluntary movement for that turn, without imposing Speed0 or preventing actual involuntary transport. Grovel: become/remain Prone for that turn if capable, without automatically losing Actions or legal crawling. Other one-word commands may require at most one coherent ordinary action/movement/interaction within this same turn and the limitations below; the word never grants an otherwise unavailable action or named condition. The target/controller chooses lawful details, safe route and object where the word leaves choices.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: No compelled attack/knowingly harmful act, direct self-harm, known serious hazard, protected/private secret disclosure, permanent surrender/ownership transfer, knowing binding-oath/duty violation, spell or optional limited-resource expenditure. If circumstances make the commanded behavior prohibited or impossible before execution, that portion fails rather than rewriting the word or extending the deadline. One pending Command application per target across casters; a later legally established failed-save application replaces it. No restoration of an older replaced command or spent hard-control allowance. A saved-against/wholly invalid new command creates no replacement. Simultaneous unresolved decisions use ordinary initiative order, else a fixed neutral order, never a caster’s after-the-fact preference. Unaffected Actions/BA/Reactions and movement remain; one-time Drop/Approach/Flee instructions finish once satisfied, while Halt/Grovel persist for the affected turn. Compelled movement uses the target’s movement and can provoke normal opportunity attacks. Hard whole-Action/turn components use the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independent printed components retain their own defense checks. A successfully established hard component claims the allowance once, not again each turn; ending, dispelling, replacing or suppressing it does not refund the encounter history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, actual one-word compulsion for1round. NEW: WIS/hearing/language and bounded safe-command procedure. Exact completions retain other bounded words, define ordinary action costs, nonbanking competition and one-time versus turn-long instructions; they do not turn compulsion into voluntary advice.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect. State one reasonable finite course of conduct in ordinary language before the save; actual hearing, understanding, hidden reasonableness and prohibitions are resolved after paid commitment.
operational.duration: Up to eight elapsed hours, no concentration. Ends earlier on task completion, actual removal, or when the remaining task becomes materially unreasonable, prohibited or no longer reasonably achievable in its established scope. A single identifiable conditional trigger may be awaited within the same original eight-hour deadline; no expiry reset on initiative, plane or circumstance changes.
operational.resolution: If the target cannot hear/understand or the instruction is invalid, establish nothing and choose no substitute task. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new compulsion. Failure: establish the legal finite task. If that defined task necessarily requires any whole ordinary Actions, even after a future conditional trigger, establish/claim its hard-control component once now. If blocked, only an independently meaningful compliant soft task achievable with legal movement/interactions may establish. A genuinely established soft remainder can replace a prior Suggestion; a wholly invalid, saved-against or wholly blocked attempt cannot. One active Suggestion per target across casters; a later established task replaces the older without restoring it or refunding hard history.
operational.effect: The target genuinely pursues the established reasonable task using only its existing ordinary movement, Action and interaction permissions. Examples include ordinary travel, finite work, waiting/guarding, delivering/retrieving an ordinary item, speaking or meeting someone. An ordinary hostile act is possible only when actually reasonable given its existing beliefs, loyalties, knowledge and circumstances; the caster gains no diagnostic of those facts. Legal route, method and unspecified details remain target/controller choices. The persistent instruction’s priority timestamp is successful establishment and it uses shared Compelled Budget Arbitration at each relevant opportunity. Outside initiative use ordinary elapsed work/travel; when combat timing matters, establish ordinary initiative and existing budgets. No repeating virtual control cycle or additional Actions is granted.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: No indefinite obey-me relationship, direct self-harm, knowingly serious hazard, unreasonable betrayal/murder of a recognized ally, compelled spellcasting/RP, consumables/charges/limited-use resources, protected/private secrets, permanent surrender of materially valuable property or knowing binding-oath/duty violation. Reasonable ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks and normal required ammunition within actual limits; optional finite riders and special finite-feature ammunition remain forbidden. A task established without a hard component never acquires one later. If new obstacles would necessarily require an unreserved whole Action, use an achievable legal alternative within its original soft scope or end the remaining compulsion. Mere delay/inconvenience or a temporary obstruction does not end a still-reasonable achievable finite task. No repeat save or separate harm-ending clause is added; new violence/facts may instead make remaining conduct unreasonable. Bonus Actions, Reactions and separately granted extra Actions are not commandeered. No hidden future information or new communication ability is supplied. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. Successful establishment claims it once, not per affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing a hard component never refunds the history. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independently printed components retain their actual defenses. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application. Later suppression of an established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, actual reasonable-suggestion compulsion for up to eight hours; effect overrides Instantaneous placeholder. NEW: WIS, hearing/language, no concentration, finite task/conditional trigger, actual reasonableness/resource/conduct limits, establishment-time hard reservation, same-spell replacement and persistent arbitration timestamp. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
